nodes.title: The Incognito Year
nodes.historical_context: The Pandavas assume disguises: Yudhishthira as Kanka, Bhima as Ballava, Arjuna as Brihannala, Nakula as Granthika, Sahadeva as Tantipala, and Draupadi as Sairandhri.

nodes.title: The Virata War
nodes.historical_context: The Kaurava army attacks Virata to steal cattle and expose the Pandavas. Arjuna heads out with Prince Uttara.
